describe.description: The creature is shown in strict right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background, standing alert with all four legs on the ground and head held high. It has the compact, sturdy build of a small equine with a deep chest, slightly arched back, slender legs and a relatively large head. The coat is short and coarse, light to medium brown over most of the body with a paler, almost white belly and muzzle, and is overlaid with irregular dark brown to black striping. The mane is short, stiff and upright along the top of the neck, the ears are large and pointed, and the tail is thin with a dark tuft at the tip. The overall impression is of a donkey-like animal bearing zebra-like stripes, rendered in detailed natural-history illustration style.

describe.description: A slender four-legged equid shown in right-facing profile with a donkey-like body. The coat is shaggy brown-gray on the head, neck and back, fading to pale off-white on the muzzle, underside of the neck, belly and lower legs. The head is long with a white muzzle, dark nostril, dark eye with a pale ring, and two very long upright ears. A short stiff upright mane runs along the top of the neck. The torso is narrow with a slightly swayed back and a dark stripe along the spine. The legs are long and slender ending in small dark single hooves. A thin tail with a dark tuft hangs from the rear. Dark narrow stripes mark the neck, shoulder, torso, hindquarters and legs.
